console.label: Console
console.title: GOOPS
console.hintBack: Pull the periscope to go back
console.upgradesLocked: Upgrades: {n} scraps saved. Upgrading opens at rank {rank}.

upgrades.title: Upgrades
upgrades.equipLabel: Equip {name}: take it into the shift
upgrades.swapped: {name} stays behind: one active at a time.
upgrades.respecLabel: Respec: take back every level, all your scraps return
upgrades.respecDone: All upgrades taken back: {n} scraps to spend.

circuitStabilizer.name: Circuit Stabilizer
circuitStabilizer.desc: The visor holds its picture longer before it starts to fade. Max level: fixing it takes 1 step less.

autoPopper.name: Auto-Popper
autoPopper.desc: After a rupture the pressure drains slower, so you get more time to pop the goop that's left.

capacitorEfficiency.name: Capacitor Efficiency
capacitorEfficiency.desc: Each pop drains the laser less. Max level: fixing it takes 1 step less.

cooldownBooster.name: Cooldown Booster
cooldownBooster.desc: An active: it charges during the shift. Fire it to keep every running machine calm for longer before it can break again.

gearLubrication.name: Gear Lubrication
gearLubrication.desc: The controls cool down faster. Max level: fixing them takes 1 step less.

focusMode.name: Focus Mode
focusMode.desc: The tank runs slower while you're at the console during a shift.

denseGoop.name: Dense Goop
denseGoop.desc: Goop falls faster: a harder shift, but more drops to seal cracks with. Take it back any time.

pressureControl.name: Pressure Control
pressureControl.desc: Pressure takes longer to rise, so new cracks come slower too.

brokeLaser.keys: Laser broken — W or ↑ to fix
brokeLaser.mouse: Laser broken — flick up to fix
brokeLaser.phone: Laser broken — swipe up to fix

brokeVisor.keys: Visor broken — W or ↑ to fix
brokeVisor.mouse: Visor broken — flick up to fix
brokeVisor.phone: Visor broken — swipe up to fix

brokeControls.keys: Controls broken — W or ↑ to fix
brokeControls.mouse: Controls broken — flick up to fix
brokeControls.phone: Controls broken — swipe up to fix

messages.quotaMet: Quota met! Every crack now is a bonus.

upright.label: Turn your phone upright
upright.title: Turn your phone upright
upright.message: Goops plays upright. Your shift waits right where you left it.

end.swipe: ⇧ Swipe up to end the day
end.wonCracks: Quota met. Then too many open cracks broke the tank.
end.wonOverflow: Quota met. Then the tank overfilled and burst.
end.lostCracks: Too many open cracks broke the tank before you met the quota.
end.lostOverflow: The tank overfilled and burst before you met the quota.

sample.welcome: Goop drops into the tank from up here.

fastDrop.keys: Too slow? Hold S (or ↓) to fast-drop it.
fastDrop.mouse: Too slow? Hold S (or ↓) to fast-drop it.
fastDrop.phone: Too slow? Drag down to fast-drop it.

fastDropHint.keys: Hold S to drop it faster.
fastDropHint.mouse: Hold S to drop it faster.
fastDropHint.phone: Drag down and hold to drop it faster.

zap.keys: Goop on the line can be zapped. Click the green goop.
zap.mouse: Goop on the line can be zapped. Click the green goop.
zap.phone: Goop on the line can be zapped. Tap the green goop.

sample.zapHint: Zap the green goop to clear it.
sample.done: That's the sample lesson. The shift carries on from here.

toConsole.keys: Press W or ↑ for the console.

pauseMenu.keys: That's the pause menu. Use W or ↑ for the console.
pauseMenu.mouse: That's the pause menu. Close it, then flick up for the console.
pauseMenu.phone: That's the pause menu. Close it, then flick up for the console.

stillBroken.keys: It's still broken. Press W or ↑ to go back to the console.
stillBroken.mouse: It's still broken. Flick up to go back to the console.
stillBroken.phone: It's still broken. Flick up to go back to the console.

shared.fullyPaused: The game is fully paused for this moment. Normally it keeps running at {consoleSpeed}% speed while you're here.

visor.broke: Your visor broke. The view will glitch until you fix it.
visor.fix: Drag the slider toward the light.
visor.fixSlide: Drag the slider toward the light.
visor.fixed:
Fixed!
Dropping the Goop faster keeps the Visor charged.

broke.keys: Your laser broke. Each zap now takes two clicks: prime, then zap.
broke.mouse: Your laser broke. Each zap now takes two clicks: prime, then zap.
broke.phone: Your laser broke. Each zap now takes two taps: prime, then zap.

laser.fix: Drag the slider toward its blinking light.
laser.fixed:
Fixed!
Zapping drains the Laser. Every piece that lands recharges it.

controls.broke: Your controls overheated. Held spins now turn the tank slowly.
controls.fix: Turn the dial to the blinking light.
controls.fixed:
Fixed!
Every spin heats the Controls. Short rests cool them.

unlock-window.window: New at your rank: this window shows the next piece.

swap.keys: Swap unlocked! Hold Right Shift (or R) to trade the falling piece for the next one.
swap.mouse: Swap unlocked! Hold the mouse still on the tank (or hold Right Shift) to trade the falling piece for the next one.
swap.phone: Swap unlocked! Hold your finger still on the tank to trade the falling piece for the next one.

unlock-upgrades.upgrades: Upgrades unlocked! Spend your scraps here.

console-note.slow: The tank keeps running at {consoleSpeed}% speed while you're here.

pull.keys: Your first day! Press ↓ or Enter to pull the periscope.
pull.mouse: Your first day! Drag the periscope down to start.
pull.phone: Your first day! Pull the periscope down to start.

pullHint.keys: Press ↓ or Enter, or click the periscope.
pullHint.mouse: Pull the periscope all the way down, or just click it.
pullHint.phone: Pull the periscope all the way down, or just tap it.

first-day.falls: Goop drops into the tank from the top.

fastDrop.keys: Slow, right? Hold S or ↓ to fast drop.
fastDrop.mouse: Slow, right? Drag down on the tank to fast drop.
fastDrop.phone: Slow, right? Drag down on the tank to fast drop.

fastDropHint.keys: Hold S or ↓. It falls faster while you hold.
fastDropHint.mouse: Drag down and hold. It falls faster while you hold.
fastDropHint.phone: Drag down and hold. It falls faster while you hold.

turn.keys: Q or E turns the piece. Turn it, then drop it.
turn.mouse: Click left or right of the piece to turn it.
turn.phone: Tap left or right of the piece to turn it.

turnHint.keys: Press Q or E to turn it.
turnHint.mouse: Click beside the piece to turn it.
turnHint.phone: Tap beside the piece to turn it.

first-day.pressureLine: Pressure rises over time. Goop under the line can be zapped.

zapYellow.keys: Now click the yellow goop to zap it.
zapYellow.mouse: Now click the yellow goop to zap it.
zapYellow.phone: Now tap the yellow goop to zap it.

first-day.join: Same colours join into one blob. Fresh goop fills up first.
first-day.zapBlob: Zap the blue blob once it's full.
first-day.stillFilling: Still filling. Wait until it's full.
first-day.vent: Zapping lets out a little pressure. Big blobs let out more.
first-day.crack: A crack! Cover it with goop of the same colour.
first-day.integrity: Open cracks wear down the tank. This bar is its health.

spin.keys: The piece always falls down the middle. A / D or ← / → spins the tank.
spin.mouse: The piece falls down the middle. Drag sideways to spin the tank.
spin.phone: The piece falls down the middle. Drag sideways to spin the tank.

first-day.spinHint: Spin until the landing shadow sits over the crack.
first-day.tryAgain: Try again. Spin until the shadow is over the crack.
first-day.seal: The crack shows through the goop. Zap that goop to seal it.

sealHint.keys: Click the green goop on the crack.
sealHint.mouse: Click the green goop on the crack.
sealHint.phone: Tap the green goop on the crack.

first-day.sealed: Sealed! Seal {total} cracks a day to meet your quota.
first-day.outOfView: You only see part of the tank. Arrows point to cracks out of view.
first-day.high: Cracks form up high too. Stack goop under them to reach.
first-day.highHint: Build under the crack, then drop green on it.
first-day.sealHigh: Now zap the green goop to seal it.
first-day.redX: Wrong colour. See the red X? Zap that goop to uncover it.
first-day.freePlay: Cracks come faster as pressure rises. Zap goop to keep it down.
first-day.quota: Seal {left} more to meet the quota.
first-day.quotaHint: Cover a crack with its colour, then zap it.
first-day.tooFull: Too full! I've cleared some. Zap more often.
first-day.capped: Zap goop to let pressure out.
first-day.rupture: The tank broke! Zap all the goop you can before pressure hits zero.
first-day.clockOut: Day one done! Back to the console to clock out.
